source_alignment.note: Intent semantics and response placeholders are aligned to the current synthetic BI calculations and page structures. No BI code or UI was modified.

purpose: Bilingual business-analysis intent bank covering campaigns, opportunity/gap signals, reports, and cross-page analytical questions. Values must be resolved dynamically from current BI state.

integration_contract.dynamic_data_rule: Resolve all metrics, rankings, rates, campaign values, opportunity signals, and report breakdowns from existing BI data/functions at query time.
integration_contract.campaign_rule: Campaign answers must respect category/audience filters and the selected campaign when the user does not name another campaign.
integration_contract.opportunity_rule: Opportunity rankings use the current prototype signal index and must never be reframed as profit, ROI, investment attractiveness, or financial feasibility.
integration_contract.report_rule: Report answers and exports inherit the active filters and remain aggregated/synthetic.
integration_contract.cross_page_rule: Cross-page comparisons must use one consistent active filter context unless the user explicitly requests different contexts.
truthfulness: All data is synthetic/illustrative prototype data.
No personal data or individual identification.
No pricing, revenue projections, ROI, break-even, or financial feasibility assumptions.
No guarantee that a demand/supply signal represents a successful commercial opportunity.

bank_plan.planned_part_04_role: Conversation context, follow-ups, contextual suggestions, aliases, routing metadata.
